ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio; approximately 15% high-intensity (white) pixels distributed as speckling against an 85% low-intensity (black/dark grey) base.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white mottling and fine speckling concentrated along the lower trailing margins and distal tips; a singular, isolated high-contrast white ring is visible on the mid-right lobe; central fluke area consists of a contiguous low-intensity dark mass.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Wide, shallow U-shaped notch; calculated internal angle of approximately 115 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-amplitude irregular serrations on the left lobe featuring multiple deep, jagged indentations; right lobe exhibits a more continuous, lower-amplitude serrated profile.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve along the posterior edge of both lobes, tapering into acute, upwardly-curved tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, textured, high-contrast pixel clusters (off-white/tan) located exclusively at the apical tips of both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple deep, irregular notches on the trailing edge of the left lobe indicating significant tissue loss; prominent barnacle colonization on the distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: A highly distinctive high-contrast white annulus (circular ring) located on the ventral surface of the right lobe.
